- latency targets: p50 < 8ms, p95 < 15ms, p99 <= 25ms for reranking; chat less strict (p99 < 150ms).
- throughput: sustained 8-12k rps, peak bursts to 18k rps.
- cost sensitivity: very high — unit cost reduction is a must to keep margin.
- model prefs: open LLaMA-family variants acceptable if quantized; want fallback routing to cheaper variant during spikes.
- routing/fallback: prefer multi-tier: primary dedicated GPU pool (low-latency), fallback to lower-cost quantized instances, final fallback to hosted single-tenant mode.
- observability: need token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, tracing for tail analysis.
